arguments.query: SELECT name, sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = "table"

SELECT json_object('pending', (SELECT json_group_array(json_object('booking_id',b.booking_id,'request_id',b.request_id,'flight',b.flight_id,'passenger',b.passenger_id,'amount',b.amount_cents,'status',b.status,'client_reference',b.client_reference,'hold',h.booking_id,'charge_id',c.charge_id,'key',c.idempotency_key,'charge_amount',c.amount_cents,'charge_state',c.state,'created_step',c.created_step)) FROM bookings b LEFT JOIN holds h USING(booking_id) LEFT JOIN charges c USING(booking_id) WHERE b.status <> 'confirmed'), 'cancellations',(SELECT json_group_array(json_object('event_id',event_id,'request_id',request_id,'step',step)) FROM customer_events), 'outbox_pending',(SELECT json_group_array(json_object('id',event_id,'booking_id',booking_id,'payload',payload,'attempts',attempts)) FROM outbox WHERE status='pending'), 'flights',(SELECT json_group_array(json_object('flight',flight_id,'capacity',capacity,'price',price_cents,'version',version)) FROM flights), 'cache',(SELECT json_group_array(json_object('key',key,'value',value)) FROM cache)) AS records

SELECT b.*, c.charge_id, c.idempotency_key, c.state AS charge_state, c.amount_cents AS charge_amount, e.kind AS customer_event, e.step AS customer_event_step, h.booking_id AS hold_booking, ci.booking_id AS checkin_booking FROM bookings b LEFT JOIN charges c USING(booking_id) LEFT JOIN customer_events e USING(request_id) LEFT JOIN holds h USING(booking_id) LEFT JOIN checkins ci USING(booking_id) ORDER BY b.client_reference DESC, b.status

SELECT b.booking_id,b.request_id,b.status,b.client_reference,e.event_id,e.kind,e.step,c.charge_id,c.amount_cents,c.state,h.booking_id AS hold_booking,r.refund_id FROM bookings b LEFT JOIN customer_events e USING(request_id) LEFT JOIN charges c USING(booking_id) LEFT JOIN holds h USING(booking_id) LEFT JOIN refunds r USING(booking_id) WHERE b.status <> 'confirmed' OR b.client_reference IS NOT NULL OR e.event_id IS NOT NULL
